facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Tom lived with Aunt Polly. She told him to paint a fence. Tom did not want to work. Tom hated work.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Tom Sawyer was a clever boy who lived by the Mississippi River. His Aunt Polly took care of him and often got annoyed with him. One Saturday morning, she told him to paint the long white fence. Tom hated work and did not want to paint the fence at all. He looked at the long fence and felt very sorry for himself. All his friends were playing while he was stuck with a paintbrush.
facts.Word cards: paint = 칠하다 / fence = 울타리 / had to = ~해야 했다 / Aunt Polly = 폴리 이모
